messages:
maria: Quick flag - Rollouts p99 for /v1/embeddings jumped from ~460ms -> ~980ms right after we changed routing weights. endpoint pane per-host p99 still ~470ms. p50/p95 match. anyone have a fast checklist?

frank: first things: include_retries parity, tdigest sketch sizes, sample rates at ingress vs worker, and time anchor (event_time vs ingest_time).

lee: also check whether the Rollouts view uses merged tdigest sketches from the aggregator while the endpoint pane computes host histograms locally. merge + sampling mismatches are classic.

telemetry-bot: deploy "route-weight-shift-2027-08-03" applied at 2027-08-03T14:12:00Z. ingress.adaptive_sample=0.12 -> 0.05 for tier=low. aggregator.tdigest_sketch_size=64.

tara: I ran quick recompute on raw events for the 30m window using event_time and ingest_time: raw_event_time_p99=972ms; raw_ingest_time_p99=468ms. endpoint pane uses ingest_time by default. Rollouts uses event_time.

maria: aha. so it's a time-anchor mismatch not necessarily a merge math bug. that explains why endpoint pane stayed low.

frank: good catch. event_time is correct for SLOs but surprises product folks when ingest delays/backfills exist. any idea why event_time p99 spiked?

tara: digging - looks like a short cache-warm period in one region caused a burst of long tail requests that were all event-timestamped inside the window, but the worker-side ingest for some of those arrived late and got counted in the next ingest_time window.

lee: also, aggregator was merging sketches from multiple regions and we increased global cache_ttl during the rollout to reduce churn, so stale merged sketch + event_time window could exaggerate the spike.

maria: mitigation for now: switch Rollouts to ingest_time for the next hour so PMs don't see noisy alerts, and purge the global merged sketch for that window.

telemetry-bot: action taken: Rollouts.time_anchor set to ingest_time at 2027-08-03T14:35:10Z; cache purge for route 'emb-v1' window 2027-08-03T14:00:00Z-2027-08-03T14:30:00Z executed.

frank: solid. follow-ups: 1) add a provenance pill showing quantile_source (merged-tdigest | raw-recompute | host-hist), time_anchor, sample_count, sketch_size, last_merge_time; 2) add an automated divergence alert when rollup p99 vs recompute p99 > 25% for 5m; 3) document runbook entry about not increasing global cache_ttl during routing experiments.

tara: filed MET-7801 for provenance UI + divergence alert + runbook note. assigned to lee.

lee: will take MET-7801. long-term: prefer recompute-weighted for p99 when total_sample_count < threshold or when sketch_size small; merged tdigest fine for medians but risky at extremes. will draft proposal.

maria: thanks everyone. quick ask for the UI: when users hover a quantile show a one-line explanation: "event_time shows request start times (best for SLOs); ingest_time shows when metric ingested (less noisy)." that would save time.

frank: +1 to the tooltip. also add a small "why different" link to the chart that points to the runbook section once it's live.

tara: recompute sanity-check after purge: recompute_event_time_p99=474ms (post-purge), recompute_ingest_time_p99=470ms, rollouts_now=472ms. all aligned. closing incident. :white_check_mark:
